root_cause.mechanism: The commit replaced `pkgutil.get_loader(import_name)` with `importlib.util.find_spec(import_name)`. In Python 3.11+, `find_spec` raises `ValueError` if `import_name` is `"__main__"` and `sys.modules["__main__"].__spec__` is `None`, which is the case when running a script directly. Previously `pkgutil.get_loader` returned `None` in this case, which Flask handled correctly.
